remarks: Welcome to Victoria Commons! Tranquil picturesque enclave of 3 separate homes. Amenities of condo style living yet enjoy the comforts of your own home. This charming bright barn style home was totally renovated and designed for today's lifestyle with vaulted ceiling and beams, energy efficient, open floor plan with only two steps to upper bedroom level. Possible 3rd bedroom/office, Great Rm open to Custom Kitchen with granite tops and S/S appliances separate laundry area off kitchen. Primary Suite offers generous walk-in closet with full bath separate walk-in shower and soaking tub with dual sink vanity. Incudes use of 2 car garage, lawn care and snow removal for driveway. Great commuter location and close to YMCA. Owner related. Subject to satisfactory credit and rental application and references.
